rca_of_the_issue: The review_request claimed 'new endpoints around lines 350-550 (Case Studies, Team, Certificates, Awards, Reviews, Public sub-resources)'. Reality on disk: only the two PUBLIC endpoints exist (case-studies & awards at lines 725-732). The provider-scoped /api/me/{case-studies,team,certificates,awards,reviews} routes were never added, and CompanyUpdate was never expanded. The previous iteration's seed already creates collections (team_members, certificates) that the public company-detail endpoint reads, so the data path exists — only the HTTP handlers are missing. Reproduction: run `grep -n 'case-studies\|/me/team\|/me/certificates\|/me/awards\|/me/reviews' /app/backend/server.py` — only the two public lines appear.
